name: sidestory
description: Rich sidestories beside your code: diagrams, live React widgets and prose linked both ways to the code. Written by you or any AI agent.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Sidestories render safely in Restricted Mode, but a panel left open isn't restored automatically: open it again yourself.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Sidestories are resolved against files on disk.

sidestory.followCursorInDiagrams.description: Ring the boxes and links in a sidestory (data-explain-ref, data-explain-code) whose code holds the editor cursor. Steps change only for code a section covers.

sidestory.dimUnfocused.description: Dim code outside the active step when you move through a sidestory.

sidestory.clickHighlightSeconds.markdownDescription: How long the code stays highlighted after you click a code link or an inline reference in a sidestory, or a widget points at it, in seconds. `0` keeps it until the next one.

sidestory.clickFrame.markdownDescription: After the click highlight (`#sidestory.clickHighlightSeconds#`) fades, keep a frame around those lines until the next one, or until the panel shows another sidestory.

markdownEnumDescriptions: A small card in the panel shows the first lines of the code.
The code's lines are marked in editors that already show its file (none is opened or scrolled).
The card and the mark in visible editors.
Nothing: only a click shows the code.
sidestory.hoverPreview.markdownDescription: What resting the pointer on a link or a diagram box in a sidestory (or tabbing to one) shows of its code. It never moves the editor, the cursor or focus; a click still opens the code.

sidestory.widgets.enabled.markdownDescription: Run interactive widgets in sidestories. Widgets are code from the repository: they never run in Restricted Mode, and each workspace asks before running them. A repository's own settings can't turn this on.

sidestory.codeLens.enabled.markdownDescription: Show a CodeLens above code that a sidestory explains (at most 30 per file; hidden while that sidestory is open in a panel).

sidestory.gutter.enabled.markdownDescription: Mark the first line of code a sidestory explains with a book in the gutter, and in the overview ruler.

sidestory.statusBar.enabled.markdownDescription: Show in the status bar which sidestory explains the cursor's line, when no open panel shows it.

sidestory.sidebar.followPanel.markdownDescription: Select the sidestory a panel shows in the Sidestories view.

sidestory.changes.defaultBase.markdownDescription: The branch, tag or commit to compare branches with (for example `develop` or `origin/main`). The base is, in order: the one picked with **Sidestory: Set Base…** for the branch; the `base` of a sidestory added on the branch; the branch base the Git extension recorded (`branch.<name>.vscode-merge-base`); this setting; the remote's default branch; then `main` or `master`.

sidestory.changes.includeUncommitted.description: Compare the working tree (with staged, unstaged and untracked changes) rather than the last commit, for coverage, its decorations and the diffs steps open.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Steps open plain editors (removed code in a read-only view of the old file). **Open Changes with Base** in the editor’s title bar switches a modified file to the branch’s diff; later steps in that file stay in the diff.
Steps of a sidestory with a base open the branch’s merge diff, at the step’s side. In a diff the step’s lines get a frame and the step’s title.
sidestory.changes.openStepsIn.description: Where the steps of a sidestory that explains a branch (one with a "base") open.

sidestory.changes.suggestExplain.description: Offer "Copy Prompt: Explain This Branch" under "This branch" in the Sidestories view when the branch has changes and no sidestory explains it yet.

sidestory.changes.markUnexplained.description: Mark unexplained changes in the gutter of the branch’s diffs, also when no sidestory with this base is open.

enumDescriptions: Only on this machine, in .sidestory/.local (git ignores it)
sidestory.comments.defaultLocation.description: Where new comment threads are kept. Share or Make Local moves a thread later.

sidestory.comments.authorName.description: The name on your comments. Empty: git's user.name in trusted workspaces. Never an email address.

enumDescriptions: Every line of every file (overlaps the GitHub Pull Requests extension, which asks which provider to use)
sidestory.comments.ranges.description: Where the editor's comment + appears for Sidestory comments.

sidestory.comments.stateDir.description: Folder for comment delivery records and presence, shared with the Sidestory comments plugin. Empty: the default per-user folder.

enumDescriptions: --dangerously-load-development-channels (needed while Sidestory is not on the channel allowlist)
--channels (when your organization allowlists the plugin in allowedChannelPlugins)
sidestory.claude.channelFlag.description: The flag the copied Claude command uses to turn on Sidestory's channel.

colors.description: Background of the lines the active sidestory step is about.
Left bar on the active step's lines when the step has no accent color.
Frame, overview ruler mark and title of the active step's lines in a diff editor. Pick a color the diff's inserted and removed lines don't use.
Frame left around the lines a code link or inline reference opened, after their brief highlight fades.
Background of the active step's lines in a diff editor, over the diff's inserted and removed colors.
Background of identifiers the active step highlights.
Border of identifiers the active step highlights.
Background of the lines a link in a sidestory points at while the pointer rests on it (sidestory.hoverPreview).
Left border of the lines a link in a sidestory points at while the pointer rests on it (high contrast themes, where backgrounds are transparent).
Background of the lines a widget highlights in the editor.
Border of the lines a widget highlights in the editor (high contrast themes, where backgrounds are transparent).
Sidestory sections whose code changed a lot.
Sidestory sections whose code can't be found.
Overview ruler mark for code a sidestory explains (with sidestory.gutter.enabled).
Gutter and overview ruler mark for changed lines no step explains yet (in the branch’s diffs).
Icon color of partly explained changes in the This File view.
Badge color of changed files whose changes are all explained or marked trivial (Explorer, Source Control, Git Tree Compare).
Badge color of changed files with changes no step explains yet, or whose step needs a look (Explorer, Source Control, Git Tree Compare).

viewsWelcome.contents:
Open a folder to see its sidestories.
[Open Folder](command:workbench.action.files.openFolder)

No sidestories in this workspace yet. A sidestory is a folder in .sidestory/ with a page and a manifest.json, shown beside the code and linked to it.
[Read the Guide](https://github.com/mozru/sidestory/blob/main/docs/GUIDE.md)
[Copy a Prompt for Your Agent](command:sidestory.copyAgentPrompt)
Or, in Claude Code, run /plugin install sidestory@sidestory, then ask: "Explain how … works, with Sidestory."
